import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

uint64_max = np.iinfo(np.uint64).max
valid = np.array([1_000_000, 2_000_000], dtype=np.uint64)

# Helper to record either exception name/message or repr(value)
def rec(label, thunk):
    try:
        v = thunk()
        # Convert to a JSON-ish stable representation
        if isinstance(v, (pd.Timestamp, pd.Timedelta)):
            out = str(v)
        elif isinstance(v, (pd.DatetimeIndex, pd.TimedeltaIndex)):
            out = str(list(v.astype(object)))
        elif isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
            out = str(v.tolist())
        else:
            out = str(v)
        probe(label, out)
    except Exception as e:
        probe(label, f"EXC:{type(e).__name__}:{e}")

# Scalar cases
rec('to_datetime_scalar_raise', lambda: pd.to_datetime(uint64_max, unit='ns', errors='raise'))
rec('to_datetime_scalar_coerce', lambda: pd.to_datetime(uint64_max, unit='ns', errors='coerce'))
rec('Timestamp_scalar', lambda: pd.Timestamp(uint64_max, unit='ns'))

rec('to_timedelta_scalar_raise', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(uint64_max, unit='ns', errors='raise'))
rec('to_timedelta_scalar_coerce', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(uint64_max, unit='ns', errors='coerce'))
rec('Timedelta_scalar', lambda: pd.Timedelta(uint64_max, unit='ns'))

# Array cases
arr = np.array([uint64_max], dtype=np.uint64)
rec('to_datetime_array_raise', lambda: pd.to_datetime(arr, unit='ns', errors='raise'))
rec('to_datetime_array_coerce', lambda: pd.to_datetime(arr, unit='ns', errors='coerce'))
rec('to_timedelta_array_raise', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(arr, unit='ns', errors='raise'))
rec('to_timedelta_array_coerce', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(arr, unit='ns', errors='coerce'))

# Valid cases (should match int64-cast results)
rec('to_datetime_valid', lambda: pd.to_datetime(valid, unit='ns'))
rec('to_timedelta_valid', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(valid, unit='ns'))
rec('to_datetime_valid_int64', lambda: pd.to_datetime(valid.astype(np.int64), unit='ns'))
rec('to_timedelta_valid_int64', lambda: pd.to_timedelta(valid.astype(np.int64), unit='ns'))
